title.narrative: Support to the Centre for Neglected Tropical Diseases (CNTD) Through an Accountable Grant With the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine

description.narrative: This activity Support to the Centre for Neglected Tropical Diseases (CNTD) Through an Accountable Grant With the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine is a component of Support for the Elimination of Lymphatic Filariasis (LF) 2009-2019 reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £38,872,273. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Infectious disease control, Basic health care.
